name: Spring: Field to Constructor Injection
description: A Spring-managed dependency moved from an @Autowired field to a constructor parameter.

name: Spring: Aware Callback to Constructor Injection
description: A dependency a Spring *Aware setter callback used to hand over (BeanFactory, ClassLoader, Environment, ResourceLoader) is now received through the constructor.

name: Spring: @Component
description: A type registered as a generic Spring-managed bean.

name: Spring: @Service
description: A type registered as a Spring-managed application service bean.

name: Spring: @Repository
description: A type registered as a Spring-managed persistence/repository bean.

name: Spring: Configuration/Beans
description: A @Configuration class or @Bean method defining Spring-managed wiring.

name: Spring: Transaction Management
description: A method or class annotated to participate in Spring-managed transactions.

name: JPA: Entity Relationship
description: A JPA relationship mapping (@OneToMany, @ManyToOne, etc.) between entities.

name: JPA: Fetch/Cascade Configuration
description: Fetch strategy (eager/lazy) or cascade behavior configured on a JPA relationship.

name: Jackson: Serialization/Deserialization
description: Jackson annotations or configuration controlling JSON (de)serialization.

name: JUnit: Lifecycle/Extensions
description: JUnit lifecycle annotations or extensions controlling test setup/teardown.
